verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback flow shows an agent reading submissions and filling in an intention with proposed tasks, which suggests some automatic linking of feedback to feature work, but there is no evidence of insight detection across multiple feedback items or explicit linking to existing feature ideas/roadmap items. missing for 10: evidence of cross-feedback insight aggregation, explicit linking to existing feature ideas (not just creating new intentions), and any roadmap-prioritization signal derived from detected insights.
